mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may exacerbate CNS effects of memantine and increase risk of electrolyte-related neurological complications; memantine may alter renal function perception affecting diuretic efficacy.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; assess for signs of hyponatremia or hyperammonemia; consider potassium supplementation or alternative antihypertensive if electrolyte abnormalities develop.
